# For Next Week

### Milestone #1 (on the Vision Board)

Complete the Week 11 questions on the Vision Board.

- **Dataset You Are Choosing.** Look over the final project description and rubric. What dataset do you want to choose for the final project? If you found / are using another dataset, provide a link or explanation for us.
- **DV You Are Interested In from the Dataset.**
- **Why Are You Interested in This Topic?** I'd encourage you to try and find a topic that's related to your future career interests, so you can "write" about
- **Questions About the Dataset.** Take a look at the codebook or dataset. Do you have any questions / concerns about how you might analyze the data?
- **Questions About Pre-Registration.** For the project, I'd like you to submit some kind of pre-registration guide. You don't need to do this officially, but I want there to be some practice in thinking through how you might analyze the data BEFORE you do the data analysis work. Look over the [pre-registration guidelines](https://help.osf.io/article/330-welcome-to-registrations) from OSF and let us know if you have any questions.
